about.title: About Me
about.intro: Engineer with 4+ years building and shipping B2B and B2B2C products for enterprise clients. At Hivepower, I grew from individual contributor to frontend lead, building a client app end to end and a whitelabel platform that reduced the time required to launch new clients by ~5×. Alongside my engineering background, I bring experience in sales, teaching and product presentations. I'm at my best at the intersection of people, product and technology — understanding what needs to be solved, communicating across teams, and building the solution when needed.
about.work1: Understand what needs to be solved — working directly with clients and stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
about.work2: Communicate across teams — acting as the bridge between design, backend, business stakeholders, and clients.
about.work3: Build the solution when needed — leveraging my engineering background to deliver end-to-end implementations.
about.work4: Enable and present — from pitching products to investors to training clients, I make technical solutions accessible.

experience.title: Work Experience
experience.description: Implementing solutions and bridging clients, product, and technology
experience.hive.achievement1: Acted as the bridge between design, backend and business stakeholders, translating needs into clear technical requirements and cutting feature delivery cycles by ~50% through clearer specs, faster reviews and async-first workflows.
experience.hive.achievement2: Pitched the product to investors and prospective clients at industry events, combining technical product knowledge with a customer-facing role.
experience.hive.achievement3: Owned the development of a client's energy-consumption mobile app in my first six months, building it solo from requirements to production and giving users hourly, daily, weekly and monthly usage insights.
experience.hive.achievement4: Built the whitelabel platform (React, Ionic/Capacitor, Nx) that scaled Hivepower from 1 to 5+ enterprise clients. Configurable themes, feature flags and i18n turned new client launches into configuration rather than rebuilds, reducing launch time by ~5×.
experience.clearmix.achievement1: Led frontend development of ClearMix Logistics (Next.js, Google Maps API), a real-time scheduling and routing product for managing logistics operations.
experience.clearmix.achievement2: Co-built ClearMix Intros, a video-personalization feature designed to support new-customer acquisition through product-led growth.
experience.clearmix.achievement3: Worked closely with backend team to integrate REST APIs and ensure seamless data flow across the platform.
experience.clearmix.achievement4: Contributed to frontend code quality through peer reviews and unit testing, ensuring reliable client-facing functionality.
caseStudies.title: Leadership Case Studies
caseStudies.description: Deep dives into architectural decisions, technical leadership, and impact-driven solutions
caseStudies.nx.title: Nx Monorepo: Architecture & Codebase Audit
caseStudies.nx.subtitle: Led comprehensive analysis and modernization of enterprise-scale monorepo infrastructure.
caseStudies.nx.problem: Legacy structure with 200+ projects, inconsistent patterns, circular dependencies
caseStudies.nx.actions: Conducted full architectural audit, defined migration strategy, established governance
caseStudies.nx.impact: 50% faster builds, improved DX, scalable foundation for 20+ developers
caseStudies.charts.title: Charts & Haptics Stabilization
caseStudies.charts.subtitle: Resolved critical performance bottlenecks in real-time data visualization components.
caseStudies.charts.problem: Chart library causing crashes, memory leaks, and poor mobile UX
caseStudies.charts.actions: Profiled performance, optimized rendering, implemented haptic feedback system
caseStudies.charts.impact: Zero crashes, 60fps on mobile, improved user satisfaction scores
caseStudies.modal.contextText: I conducted a full audit of a shared Nx monorepo containing multiple React web and mobile apps. The goal was to identify architectural inconsistencies, reduce duplication, and define scalable standards for reusability and type safety across teams.
caseStudies.modal.takeawayText: This audit reinforced the value of architectural clarity and team alignment in multi-platform environments. Good code structure isn't just about components — it's about communication, consistency, and enabling every developer to work with confidence and speed.
